hero_kpi_rationale: Underlying EBITDA is the master KPI for BHP, a diversified miner whose profitability varies strongly with commodity price cycles. It neutralizes exceptional items and allows comparison of pure operating performance year over year.

kpis.signal: FY25 decline due to lower iron ore and coal prices
kpis.description: Total revenue FY25 (June 2025) in USD. Commodity cycle dominates.

ai_positioning.summary: BHP integrates AI and automation in its mining operations (autonomous trucks, predictive maintenance, process optimization) but does not position itself as a tech player. Focus on operational efficiency.
evidence: Autonomous truck fleet at Pilbara iron ore
Predictive maintenance and data analytics on equipment
Microsoft Azure partnership for cloud + AI operations

risks.title: Commodity price cyclicality and China exposure
risks.summary: BHP is extremely exposed to iron ore and copper price cycles. Chinese demand (steel construction, infrastructure) drives 60%+ of earnings. A Chinese real estate slowdown or global recession would significantly impact revenues and margins.
risks.score_rationale: 63% of revenue to China, primarily iron ore. Iron ore prices vary from $80 to $200/ton over 5 years. Structural cyclical risk inherent to the business model.

risks.title: Operational and safety risks in mines
risks.summary: Mining activity carries structural risks: fatal accidents (zero accidents remains an unachieved goal), dam failures, water contamination, geotechnical incidents. Samarco/Brumadinho remediation costs reached $8B+, shared with Vale.
risks.score_rationale: Open-pit and underground mines present permanent risks: fatal incidents, collapses, heavy equipment accidents. BHP reputation damaged by Brumadinho (Samarco 2015 partnership).

risks.title: Energy transition and climate risks
risks.summary: BHP must navigate the energy transition: thermal coal divestiture 2022, focus on copper + nickel + potash (future-facing). Scope 3 emissions from iron ore (Chinese steelmaking) remain an enormous challenge. Climate activists and ESG funds are increasing pressure.
risks.score_rationale: Growing pressure from investors/regulators on Scope 3 emissions (metallurgical coal). Net zero 2050 plan but criticized as insufficient. Stranded asset risk for divested thermal coal.
